sonnet.problem: Card 4 just asked what will belong to the LORD and its right answer was 'whatever comes out his door to greet him.' Card 5's True statement repeats that same answer ('whatever comes out his door to greet him') and adds only the burnt offering. It is largely the same point asked a second time on a consecutive card.
sonnet.rule: An answer shown on one card, right or wrong, isn't used again on a later card. ... Two lines that make the same point get one question. ... A True statement never just repeats the card before it.
